Area.description: A geographical area with a unique area code.

Crime.description: A node representing a crime in a search system.

Email.description: A node representing an email address.

Object.description: A node representing an object in a search system.

Officer.description: A node representing an officer in a search system, with properties for badge number, rank, name, and surname, and a relationship to crimes they have investigated.

Person.description: A person in the system, including their surname, NHS number, name, age, and relationships with other people.

Phone.description: A node representing a phone number.

PhoneCall.description: A node representing a phone call with properties for duration, time, date, and type.

PostCode.description: A unique identifier for a postal code.

Vehicle.description: A vehicle involved in a crime.

CALLED.description: A relationship indicating that one phone call was made by one phone.

CALLER.description: A relationship between a phone call and the phone that made the call.

CURRENT_ADDRESS.description: A relationship between a person and their current location.

FAMILY_REL.description: A relationship type that connects two people in a family.

HAS_EMAIL.description: A relationship indicating that a person has an email address.

HAS_PHONE.description: A relationship indicating that a person has a phone number.

HAS_POSTCODE.description: A relationship indicating that a location has a postal code.

INVESTIGATED_BY.description: A relationship indicating that a crime was investigated by an officer.

INVOLVED_IN.description: A relationship between an object and a crime, indicating involvement in the crime.

KNOWS.description: A relationship between two people indicating that they know each other.

KNOWS_LW.description: A relationship indicating that two people know each other via a long-term relationship.

KNOWS_PHONE.description: A relationship between two people indicating that one person has a phone number that the other person can use to contact them.

KNOWS_SN.description: A relationship indicating that two people know each other by sharing a specific social network.

LOCATION_IN_AREA.description: A relationship indicating that a location is located within an area.

OCCURRED_AT.description: A relationship indicating when a crime occurred at a specific location.

POSTCODE_IN_AREA.description: A relationship indicating that a postal code is located within a specific area.

Area.areaCode.description: A unique identifier for the area.

Crime.last_outcome.description: The outcome of the crime, such as 'resolved', 'unresolved', 'investigated', etc.

Crime.id.description: A unique identifier for the crime.

Crime.type.description: The type of crime, such as 'murder', 'robbery', 'assault', etc.

Email.email_address.description: The email address of the person.

Object.description.description: A brief description of the object.

Object.id.description: A unique identifier for the object.

Officer.badge_no.description: The unique identifier for the officer's badge.

Officer.rank.description: The rank of the officer, such as detective, sergeant, or captain.

Officer.name.description: The first name of the officer.

Officer.surname.description: The last name of the officer.

Person.surname.description: The last name of the person.

Person.nhs_no.description: The National Health Service number of the person.

Person.name.description: The full name of the person.

Phone.phoneNo.description: The phone number itself as a string.

PhoneCall.call_duration.description: The duration of the call in seconds.

PhoneCall.call_time.description: The time of the call in 24-hour format.

PhoneCall.call_date.description: The date of the call in YYYY-MM-DD format.

PhoneCall.call_type.description: The type of call (e.g., voice, video, text).

Vehicle.reg.description: The registration number of the vehicle.

Vehicle.year.description: The year the vehicle was manufactured.

FAMILY_REL.rel_type.description: A string representing the type of family relationship (e.g., parent-child, sibling, spouse).
